title: Nutrition Library Expansion & Intelligent Macro Estimation
description: The weakness of the Nutrition Database is the absolute worst point of the app. not being able to find the food you want to log, makes you want to stop using the app. And the custom food just does a standard 450 cal and macros for anything.
resolutionCommit: feat(nutrition): fix scrambled aliases, expand food library to 330+ verified staples, add live OpenFoodFacts global search, and implement intelligent culinary macro estimation replacing dummy 450 kcal

title: Today's Discipline Checkbox Overlap
description: The tick image is cutting the circle highlight in Ticked-off Disciplines
resolutionCommit: fix(habits): replace CheckCircle2 with Check inside rounded-full circle checkboxes to eliminate border clipping

title: Rest Capitalization in Sleep Card
description: Its weird that the capitalized letter is in Rest ('good Rest')
resolutionCommit: fix(sleep): correct capitalization from 'good Rest' to 'Good rest' in today's sleep quality card

title: Strict Monochromatic Stoic Design
description: Why are there new colours in the app? the whole idea was following the Stoic. app design, so there shouldnt be colour highlights. Take out the orange / red colour highlight. it should be dark black in white mode and clear white in black mode...
resolutionCommit: fix(theme): eliminate terracotta/orange highlights in favor of pure monochromatic Stoic ink black in light mode and pure white in dark mode

title: Better home page
description: in the home page, there are 4 side-to-side buttons, one leading to reflections, other to sleep, other to exercise and another to nutrition; they are so crowded! you cant read anything in the text... there must be a better way
resolutionCommit: feat(today): redesign home flourishing signals into spacious 2x2 cards with clear labels and progress indicators

title: Graphs & Evolution Views in Progress
description: I want many more graph views in the progress page!! not only reports of my history... i want to see my evolution. And in the habits part, maybe a calendar showing the days i followed my habits?
resolutionCommit: feat(progress): add 28-day habit consistency calendar matrix, 30-day adherence curve, cardio distance/speed curves, and calorie intake trajectory

title: Overflowing buttons in cardio page
description: The right-most 'Add cardio session' button is overflowing to the right
suggestedSolution: Maybe remove the text from the Sync with device button, and just keep the clock image
resolutionCommit: fix(train): compact wearable sync button to clean icon affordance to prevent horizontal overflow

title: Better history session (Collapsible with View All Modal)
description: The historic session of cardio workouts, strength workouts, sleep sessions, etc, is too extensive. It should only show a limited amount of exercises, and when you click it, there should be a popup where you can scroll and see everything
resolutionCommit: feat(train): limit inline history cards and add dedicated scrollable popup modals for all strength and cardio workouts

title: Cardio light mode surface contrast bug
description: In the light mode, in the cardio page, theres a box thats completely white and it looks weird against the warm grey of the rest of the UI
resolutionCommit: fix(theme): harmonize light mode tokens with warm paper cream surfaces and terracotta ember accents

title: Calculation of actual eaten calories from weight gain
description: It would be nice if you could get an estimate of how many actual calories you have been eating (in average) based on your measured weight gain
resolutionCommit: feat(metabolic): infer actual eaten calories based on mass balance and weight rate of change in progress view

title: Logo is completely dark in white mode
description: The Eumonia logo is completely black when you change to white mode
resolutionCommit: fix(header): harmonize header logo emblem with theme-aware raised surface and accent terracotta typography

title: Multilingual Support & Food Deduplication (Egg vs Ovos)
description: Currently, we can see Eggs and Ovos in the food options... it would be nice if there was only one 'Egg' card with aliases for search matching without cluttering the display.
resolutionCommit: feat(food): deduplicate egg entries, hide alias chip on food cards, and unify multilingual search matching

title: Automatic Macros in the custom add nutrition
description: The custom add nutrition in the atlas is nice but i mostly dont know the macros of what i eat. There should be an automated research of the macros, or the food you want added should just be sent to a list that gets looked at whenever any update is done, adding whatever was missing then.
resolutionCommit: feat(food): add 1-tap macro auto-estimation in custom food creator and auto-sync custom items to roadmap backlog

title: Recommendations & Friction Side Scroll Bug
description: In the Recommendations & Friction 'Area of App' side scroll, there's a bug not allowing you to scroll the items and see all the boxes
resolutionCommit: fix(feedback): replace horizontal overflow scroll with responsive flex-wrap grid in area picker

title: Absence of In-Set Historical Benchmarks ('Last Session Ghost')
description: When logging an active workout set, the input row is empty. Users must remember or navigate away to history to check their previous weight and reps for progressive overload.
suggestedSolution: Render subtle ghosted placeholder text showing 'Last: X kg × Y reps' in the weight and reps inputs.
resolutionCommit: feat(train): render previous performance ghost placeholders in active workout sets

title: Missing Olympic Barbell Plate Calculator
description: Entering heavy weights requires mental collar math between intense sets.
suggestedSolution: Add a quick-tap plate visualization chip (e.g. 20kg + 15kg + 2.5kg per side) in set rows.
resolutionCommit: feat(train): add barbell plate calculator with quick tap disc modal in set rows

title: Lack of Recipe and Meal Consolidation Builder
description: Athletes logging multi-ingredient meals (e.g., protein oats, daily smoothies) must enter ingredients individually every single day.
suggestedSolution: Implement a composite recipe builder with serving yield calculations.
resolutionCommit: feat(food): implement composite recipe builder modal with serving yield calculations

title: Rest Timer Lacks Device Vibration and Audio Cue
description: Athletes resting with eyes closed or phone locked miss the countdown completion.
suggestedSolution: Trigger navigator.vibrate([100, 50, 100]) and a soft Web Audio synthesizer chime when remaining rest reaches zero.
resolutionCommit: feat(train): trigger 528Hz singing bowl tone and device vibration when rest timer reaches zero

title: In-App Friction & Recommendation Feedback Sheet
description: Users need an accessible, frictionless way directly in the PWA to log bugs or feature ideas that sync to the backlog.
suggestedSolution: Add a 'Share Feedback' sheet in SettingsModal with dual sync to Firestore friction_reports and local backlog.
resolutionCommit: feat(feedback): add accessible in-app recommendation and friction submission modal

title: Exercise Atlas Selection Filter Rail Overlaps Exercise Cards
description: In the Atlas page of exercises, the muscle group / category filter tool (legs, arms, back, etc.) overlaps the exercise list items, blocking interaction and obscuring cards.
suggestedSolution: Fix flex/grid layout, sticky offset, z-index and container padding in ExerciseAtlasModal / AtlasView so filter chips remain fixed or cleanly stacked without overlapping content.
resolutionCommit: fix(train): isolate pinned exercise atlas filter rail from scrollable cards

title: Limited Food Library & Absence of Community/Custom Food Suggestion Flow
description: Built-in food options are limited. Need a continuous expansion drive and a dedicated in-app modal or button to suggest new foods to be added to default verified atlas.
suggestedSolution: Add food suggestion affordance in AddFoodModal and expand default foods database.
resolutionCommit: feat(food): expand verified food atlas with 26 staple items and add custom food suggestion flow

title: Cardio Progress Merges All Modalities into Single Aggregate
description: The cardio progress page merges all cardio activities (running, cycling, swimming, rowing) into a single progression curve, obscuring modality-specific pace and endurance gains.
suggestedSolution: Segment cardio progress by modality (Run vs Cycle vs Swim vs Row) with independent pace, distance, and HR graphs.
resolutionCommit: feat(progress): add segmented cardio progress tracking with modality filter and modality-specific PRs

title: Daily Habit Streaks Do Not Reset When a Day is Missed
description: If a user misses completing a habit on yesterday's date, currentStreak continues incrementing or stays positive instead of resetting to 0 on non-consecutive days.
suggestedSolution: Audit and fix streak calculation algorithm in Habit tracking logic to verify strict consecutive day compliance relative to local date.
resolutionCommit: fix(habits): implement deterministic consecutive streak calculation with zero-reset on missed days

title: Mood Logging Tightly Coupled to Daily Reflection Instead of Standalone Stoic Widget
description: Mood logging is buried inside the evening reflection rather than being a fast, standalone 4-quadrant check-in inspired by HowWeFeel adapted to the Stoic emotional regulation paradigm.
suggestedSolution: Decouple mood logging into a standalone quick-log check-in widget on TodayView.
resolutionCommit: feat(mind): decouple stoic mood check-in with standalone HowWeFeel 4-quadrant modal and today card

title: Light / White Mode UI and Contrast Regressions
description: While Dark Mode is polished, Clear/White theme suffers from low contrast text, unreadable badge chips, and mismatched border tokens.
suggestedSolution: Audit index.css light theme variables and fix hardcoded dark classes across components.
resolutionCommit: fix(theme): overhaul light/clear mode tokens with crisp white surfaces, high-contrast text and clean inputs

title: Cycling Pace Formatted as Min/Km Running Pace Instead of Km/h Speed
description: Cycling sessions and modality-filtered cardio progression display pace in minutes per kilometer (e.g. 2:00 /km) instead of standard cycling speed (km/h or mph), creating cognitive friction for cyclists and triathletes.
suggestedSolution: When cardio activity or selected modality is cycling/biking, compute and display speed in km/h or mph (distance / (duration / 60)) alongside or in place of min/km pace.
resolutionCommit: feat(cardio): format cycling pace as km/h or mph speed and dynamic unit suffix in progress view

title: Cardio Best Pace Metric Hardcodes '/km' Suffix in Imperial Unit System
description: ProgressView cardio best pace summary card hardcodes ' /km' suffix regardless of user unitSystem setting (imperial vs metric).
suggestedSolution: Dynamically render `/mi` when profile.unitSystem === 'imperial' and `/km` when 'metric'.
resolutionCommit: fix(cardio): render dynamic /mi vs /km pace unit suffix matching user profile unit system
